title: What’s inside the release?

scenes.heading: One tag, more than one platform
scenes.sub: Begin with the release image digest.
voice: You need to inspect an AICR container image before approving it.
A multi-platform release has an index and individual platform manifests, each identified by its own digest.
scenes.result: Pick the manifest for your platform

scenes.heading: Check where the image came from
voice: Provenance describes the source revision and workflow that built the image.
Verify the signed statement for your digest, which ties that claim to the release you're checking.

scenes.heading: Open the platform records
voice: The software bill of materials lists the components inside that platform's image.
OpenVEX records the project's triage for the vulnerabilities named in its document, alongside that inventory.

scenes.heading: Retrieve the right attestations
voice: You can find build provenance on the index or a platform manifest.
Look up the bill of materials and OpenVEX on the platform digest and verify their attestations there.
scenes.result: Platform digest leads to both records

payoff: Follow one image index into an architecture-specific manifest to find the right signed records.
